pin.title: Dobsonville, Soweto (map point estimated): girl, 11, swept away by flash floodwater after school transport drop-off, 17 Nov; body recovered 20 Nov
pin.location_note: ESTIMATED MAP POINT. Dobsonville, Soweto; drop-off in Snake Park near Dobsonville Extension 3 (IOL). Snake Park and Extension 3 are not found in Nominatim, so the pin is the Dobsonville suburb point (-26.2239, 27.8667), not the stream. Suburb level, about 2 km.

note: Research only. Nothing here is published until a record in docs/signals/location-photos.json is approved by the owner.
